title: HOPT document (treaties, gazette, Basic Law consultation)
description: One JSON per (row, lang) at output/hopt/{abbr}/{year}/{num}/{abbr}_{year}_{num}_{lang}.json. Covers five HKLII databases: bacpg (Basic Law consultation papers), bahkg (Basic Law HK Gazette), hktmc (marine codes), hktml (multilateral treaties), hkts (HK Treaty Series). No separate .txt or .html file — the document text is embedded in `content`.

db.description: Localised database name (e.g. 'HKTS' in EN, '公約' in TC).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or null when HKLII has no promulgation date (~20 of 1,149 HOPT rows — e.g. old treaties with an `nd` path segment).

body.description: Issuing body (e.g. 'International Labour Organisation'). Null for ~66% of HOPT rows where HKLII records no issuing body.

content.description: Embedded HTML — full document text. Run parser.html_to_text(content) for a plain-text rendering equivalent to the court cases' `.txt` files.
